messages:
Mia Chen: quick heads-up — i'm landing a docs PR that adds a small JSON-response-shape linter + a tiny SDK helper for graceful parsing. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4872 :eyes:
Sam Ortiz: nice. does the linter run in CI only or do you want it as a pre-commit hook too?
Mia Chen: CI for now, but i'd like a recommended pre-commit config in the migration guide. simple rule: forbid top-level free-form arrays for structured outputs unless wrapped in an envelope.
Riley Kapoor: can you paste the lint rule here? will add example snippets and a short changelog blurb.
Mia Chen: sure — draft rule (yaml-ish):
```
rule: no-top-level-array-for-structured-output
message: wrap outputs in {"result": [...] } or use "items" schema
paths: docs/examples/structured-output/*
```
Alex Wu: SDK change looks tiny — gonna add parse_safe(response, schema) helper that returns {ok: true, value} or {ok: false, errors}. pushing patch after docs land.
Sam Ortiz: how to handle existing customers that rely on raw arrays? fallback idea: the helper accepts legacy: true and will attempt to coerce if schema matches. but we should document the risk.
Mia Chen: yes — migration guide section: "Handling legacy array shapes" + code snippet and a short deprecation note. Riley, can you add a short example that shows both new envelope shape and the legacy fallback?
Riley Kapoor: on it. i can add two examples under docs/examples/structured-output/ — one small chat-to-tool example and one embeddings batch example.
Sam Ortiz: also, minor link fixes — some old examples in the sdk snippets page pointed to the old func-calling guide. i'll attach a list in the PR comments.
Mia Chen: perfect. ppl: please review the examples + link fixes in the PR. target to merge by EOD tomorrow so Alex can cut the SDK release on Friday.
Alex Wu: noted. i'll hold the SDK branch until docs PR merges. if CI is flaky, ping me and i'll revert the SDK change until we have a green merge.
deploy-bot: PR 4872 — docs/ci — build passed (all checks green) :white_check_mark:
Riley Kapoor: added examples + minimal tests. left a couple inline comments about wording.
Sam Ortiz: went through links — fixed three anchors and one dead external link (replaced with https://redwood.dev/docs/schema-guide).
Mia Chen: thanks! last ask — can someone run a quick smoke on the parse_safe snippet in the playground? link: https://playground.redwood.dev/snippets/parse-safe
Alex Wu: ran it, behaves as expected. returns {ok:false} for malformed shapes.
Mia Chen: awesome. i'll merge after i squash the tiny typo commits. anyone object?
Sam Ortiz: :+1:
Riley Kapoor: :thumbsup:
Alex Wu: :shipit:
Mia Chen: merging now. will follow up with a short note in the release notes and the migration checklist.
deploy-bot: merged PR 4872 into main by Mia Chen — commit 7a3f2d1
Mia Chen: post-merge checklist: update docs nav (sidebar) and add a short entry to the SDK changelog. adding TODOs in the PR for those items.
Sam Ortiz: noted, i'll pick up the sidebar tweak.
Riley Kapoor: I'll draft the migration checklist snippet and add it to docs/migration/tool-calling.md.
Mia Chen: thanks team!"
